main_text.p: fummo nituntur opere, Scriptoris Belgici fententiam exPhilosophia Cartesiana pullulare, quum ejus philosophiae femina plane in contrarium ducant, ac δὶς διὰ παθῶν ab illa differant. Autor harum exercitationum est D. Tobias Andreae, Medicinae & Philosophiae Doctor, utriusque facultatis primum Tuiscoburgi ad Rhenum, exinde Francofurti ad Viadrum, tum in illustri Gymnasio Sylvaducensi, denique Franequerae, ubi & diem suum obiit, Professor Celeberrimus, a quo plura subacti ingenii, & judicii acerrimi, quo valebat, haberes monimenta, si longioris vitae usura ipsi frui, datum fuisset. Adjecimus nonnulla his affinia, ex scriptis Wittichii, qui sparsit, & nomen toto sparget in orbe suum, tralatitie excerpta. Quibus plura addi possent, nisi hæc sufficere persuasi essemus. Vale & his fruere nobiscum.

page.notes: The Greek phrase "δὶς διὰ παθῶν" is printed small and is transcribed as best read. Some words in the line "Professor Celeberrimus" are rendered with a split at the line end ("forCeleberimus") in the scan; read as printed. The text continues on the next part of the page. The scan is cut off on the left; this part starts mid-page. The catchword "PRÆ-" is in capitals at the lower right. Spelling as printed ("sparsit", "sparget", "fruere").
